items.text:
Received so much kind words and support after Stellar Blade: Blood Rain revealed. We are truly moved and feel a great sense of responsibility. More than any words of thanks, we believe the best way to show our appreciation is to create a game of the highest quality that lives up to their expectations and deliver it to them as soon as possible. We will do our very best to achieve this, and we would be grateful if you would continue to follow our updates with interest. Above all, I would like to express my deepest gratitude to everyone at EVE Studio who is developing this wonderful game with passion and dedication🙏
#StellarBladeBloodRain #STELLABLADE #Evie
